text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 2625 Keele Street (Exterior Garage).

With the understanding that this Committee - Etobicoke York Panel is satisfied with the engineer's report dated May 25, 2018 from YCL Structural Designs Ltd., and, the Panel therefore deemed the work to be satisfactorily done, the Panel, as a matter of procedure, confirmed the Order to Comply, dated July 5, 2017, regarding the property located at 2625 Keele Street, because the deficiency was originally there.
